_readme: Maps each CM5 native-MQTT-Publisher topic to the ordered list of tag names carried in that topic's payload. UPDATED 2026-08-06 (second revision) to the REAL AS-BUILT configuration, generated directly from the four MQTTPub_1..4 exports taken out of 'RAIVT2 HMI 10in in cab V4 MQTT v9.01' after Coty built them in C-more -- this replaces an earlier 62-topic guess whose tag-to-topic assignment did NOT match what was actually built (the guess had g1=CountLaidDetector; as built, g1=TotalTiePlatesLaid and CountLaidDetector is g3). Layout: 40 topics, g1..g40, spread over four Publisher objects of exactly 10 topics each -- Publisher 1 = g1..g10, Publisher 2 = g11..g20, Publisher 3 = g21..g30, Publisher 4 = g31..g40. Every row is PayloadType=1 (raw tag value), so each list below has exactly one entry and the payload is that tag's value with nothing else in it. The parser in mqtt_excel_logger_action.py splits on '|' and zips positionally against these lists, so it handles either one value or several without code changes -- if a topic is ever rebuilt in C-more to pack multiple tag values into one message, just list its tag names here in the same left-to-right order. See the 'Approach 7' section of the project doc for the full design and the remaining setup steps.
